name: Kenco / The Shippers Group - Grand Prairie TX

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (32.781145,-97.017588, APPROXIMATE) and the cited 3845 Grand Lakes Way address were both off-target: 3845 Grand Lakes Way is the Inmar Rx Solutions building. Dallas County tax records (city-data) list 'WAREHOUSE SHIPPERS' (Shippers Warehouse / TSG) as a tenant at 3953 Grand Lakes Way - the correct facility. Confirmed via TruckMap/Waze listings ('Shippers Warehouse, 3953 Grand Lakes Way') and a Street View pano showing a 'TENNANT' tenant sign on the building (Tennant is a co-tenant at 3953). 3953 Grand Lakes Way is a ~1,060,075 SF Duke Realty/Prologis distribution building (Grand Lakes Industrial Park) in which TSG occupies a ~281,206 SF dedicated suite. Locked center on the building footprint at 32.79050,-97.01300.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or guard booth visible at the driveway connections off Grand Lakes Way or at the truck-court drive aisles. Street View (Dec 2024) shows open landscaped frontage and open drive aisles into the truck courts - typical Class A Duke Realty open-access spec building. truckGate=false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth. guardShack=false, remoteGs=false (no gate).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Massive 1.06M SF building with continuous dock-door banks along BOTH long faces (west and east). Counted ~130 doors total across the two faces; banded 50+. Exact count low-confidence due to scale.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run along two opposite (west and east) building faces, each with its own truck court - consistent with separate shipping vs receiving operations in a building this size. shipRcvSeparate=true, flagged uncertain (could also be one tenant using both sides).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large east-side drop yard packed with rows of parked trailers (~90 trailers visible across both courts); 50+ band. dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Truck courts are deep (~185 ft per Duke Realty park spec) - easily holds 3+ trucks queued. postGateStaging=true.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: 3953 Grand Lakes Way is a single (very large) multi-tenant building; not a multi-building campus. multipleFacilities=false. TSG occupies one suite within it.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Great Southwest / Grand Lakes industrial district between Dallas and Fort Worth on I-30 - dense metro industrial fabric, Urban.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Counts (dockDoorCount ~130, trailersVisible ~90, capacity ~160, siteAreaAcres ~42) are honest estimates for the whole 3953 building; TSG's 281k SF suite is a fraction of this. Reported at building level per audit convention.
